body: Kirby: Planet Robobot is HAL Laboratory's Nintendo 3DS platform adventure about an invasion that turns Planet Popstar into machinery. The Haltmann Works Company is stripping the world of its resources, and Kirby sets out through landscapes increasingly occupied by pipes, factories and mechanical enemies. His familiar inhaling and Copy Abilities remain useful, but a stolen suit of Robobot Armor gives him another scale of strength. A large machine becomes something to pilot, allowing Kirby to turn the invaders' equipment against the structures they have built.

The armor scans enemies and transforms to match their abilities. A sword produces mechanical blades, while other forms provide different ways to cross a stage or attack its obstacles. Its size lets Kirby shift objects that would otherwise remain fixed in place. The routes use these changes for small puzzles as well as battles, asking the player to notice where the current form might fit. Leaving the suit returns attention to Kirby's ordinary movements, giving each change in scale a practical purpose.

Stages move between foreground and background routes, using the 3DS display to make one layer interact with another. Code Cubes hidden along the way reward a more thorough search. Separate activities include the cooperative Team Kirby Clash and the small three-dimensional arenas of Kirby 3D Rumble. Hirokazu Ando and Jun Ishikawa's music accompanies a campaign that lets industrial scenery intrude on the series' bright landscapes. The contrast grows increasingly pointed as Kirby approaches the company directing the transformation of his home.
